README

Recorded documentation

Upstream documentation. Cargo examples describe the Rust crate; Add to project provides the Oven dependency.

README.md · Author-provided

futures-core

The core traits and types in for the futures library.

Usage

Add this to your Cargo.toml:

[dependencies]
futures-core = "0.3"

The current futures-core requires Rust 1.36 or later.
